verses.original: אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ וַיַּ֥עַן
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an
verses.literal: Then Job . . . replied

verses.original: ל֗וּ כַּעְשִׂ֑י שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל יִשְׂאוּ־ יָֽחַד׃ וְהַיָּתִי בְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: lū ka‘·śî šā·qō·wl yiš·šā·qêl yiś·’ū- yā·ḥaḏ wə·hay·yå̄·ṯī bə·mō·zə·na·yim
verses.literal: If only my grief could be weighed . . . and placed with my calamity on the scales

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֗ה יִכְבָּ֑ד מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֣ים עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥י לָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh yiḵ·bāḏ mê·ḥō·wl yam·mîm ‘al- kên də·ḇā·ray lā·‘ū
verses.literal: For then it would outweigh the sand of the seas no wonder . . . my words have been rash

verses.original: כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר רוּחִ֑י שֹׁתָ֣ה חֲ֭מָתָם בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥiṣ·ṣê šad·day ‘im·mā·ḏî ’ă·šer rū·ḥî šō·ṯāh ḥă·mā·ṯām bi·‘ū·ṯê ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ya·‘ar·ḵū·nî
verses.literal: For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me - my spirit drinks in their poison the terrors of God are arrayed against me

verses.original: פֶּ֥רֶא הֲיִֽנְהַק־ עֲלֵי־ דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם שּׁ֝֗וֹר יִגְעֶה־ עַל־ בְּלִילֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pe·re hă·yin·haq- ‘ă·lê- ḏe·še ’im šôr yiḡ·‘e·hō·šō- ‘al- bə·lî·lōw
verses.literal: Does a wild donkey bray over fresh grass or an ox low over its fodder

verses.original: תָּ֭פֵל הֲיֵאָכֵ֣ל מִבְּלִי־ מֶ֑לַח אִם־ יֶשׁ־ טַ֝֗עַם בְּרִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: tā·p̄êl hă·yê·’ā·ḵêl mib·bə·lî- me·laḥ ’im- yeš- ṭa·‘am bə·rîr ḥal·lā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Is tasteless food eaten without salt or is there flavor in the white of an egg

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֑י מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִנְגּ֣וֹעַ הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּדְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî mê·’ă·nāh lin·gō·w·a‘ hêm·māh kiḏ·wê laḥ·mî
verses.literal: My soul refuses to touch them they are loathsome food to me

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִ֭תֵּן שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑י תָּב֣וֹא אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃ יִתֵּ֥ן וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên še·’ĕ·lā·ṯî tā·ḇō·w ’ĕ·lō·w·ah yit·tên wə·ṯiq·wā·ṯî
verses.literal: If only . . . my request were granted and God would fulfill my hope

verses.original: אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וְיֹאֵ֣ל וִֽידַכְּאֵ֑נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝ד֗וֹ וִֽיבַצְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·w·ah wə·yō·’êl wî·ḏak·kə·’ê·nî yat·têr yā·ḏōw wî·ḇaṣ·ṣə·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: that God would be willing to crush me to unleash His hand and cut me off

verses.original: ע֨וֹד׀ וּ֥תְהִי נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗י וַאֲסַלְּדָ֣ה לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל בְ֭חִילָה כִּי־ לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ ū·ṯə·hî ne·ḥā·mā·ṯî wa·’ă·sal·lə·ḏāh lō yaḥ·mō·wl ḇə·ḥî·lāh kî- lō ḵi·ḥaḏ·tî ’im·rê qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: It still brings me comfort and joy through unrelenting . . . pain that I have not denied the words of the Holy One

verses.original: מַה־ כֹּחִ֥י כִֽי־ אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּמַה־ קִּ֝צִּ֗י כִּֽי־ נַפְשִֽׁי׃ אַאֲרִ֥יךְ
verses.transliteration: mah- kō·ḥî ḵî- ’ă·ya·ḥêl ū·mah- qiṣ·ṣî kî- nap̄·šî ’a·’ă·rîḵ
verses.literal: What strength do I have that I should still hope What is my future that I should be patient

verses.original: כֹּ֣חַ כֹּחִ֑י אֲבָנִ֣ים אִם־ בְּשָׂרִ֥י נָחֽוּשׁ׃ אִֽם־
verses.transliteration: kō·aḥ kō·ḥî ’ă·ḇā·nîm ’im- bə·śā·rî nā·ḥūš ’im-
verses.literal: Is my strength like that of stone or my flesh made of bronze . . .

verses.original: הַאִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’im ’ên ‘ez·rā·ṯî ḇî wə·ṯu·šî·yāh nid·də·ḥāh mim·men·nî
verses.literal: [Is] there any - help within me now that success is driven from me

verses.original: לַמָּ֣ס חָ֑סֶד מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ יַעֲזֽוֹב׃ וְיִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י
verses.transliteration: lam·mās ḥā·seḏ mê·rê·‘ê·hū ya·‘ă·zō·wḇ wə·yir·’aṯ šad·day
verses.literal: A despairing man [should have] the kindness of his friend even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty

verses.original: אַ֭חַי בָּגְד֣וּ כְמוֹ־ נָ֑חַל כַּאֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥay bā·ḡə·ḏū ḵə·mōw- nā·ḥal ka·’ă·p̄îq nə·ḥā·lîm ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū
verses.literal: [But] my brothers are as faithless as wadis as seasonal streams . . . that overflow

verses.original: הַקֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי־ קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם־ שָֽׁלֶג׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qō·ḏə·rîm min·nî- qā·raḥ ‘ā·lê·mōw yiṯ·‘al·lem- šā·leḡ
verses.literal: darkened because of the ice and the inflow of melting snow

verses.original: נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֭עֵת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִמְּקוֹמָֽם׃ בְּ֝חֻמּ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: niṣ·mā·ṯū bə·‘êṯ yə·zō·rə·ḇū niḏ·‘ă·ḵū mim·mə·qō·w·mām bə·ḥum·mōw
verses.literal: but ceasing in the dry season . . . [and] vanishing from their channels in the heat

verses.original: אָרְח֣וֹת יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ דַּרְכָּ֑ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ yil·lā·p̄ə·ṯū dar·kām ya·‘ă·lū ḇat·tō·hū wə·yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: Caravans turn aside from their routes they go into the wasteland and perish

verses.original: אָרְח֣וֹת תֵּמָ֑א הִ֭בִּיטוּ הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ tê·mā hib·bî·ṭū hă·lî·ḵōṯ šə·b̲āʾ qiw·wū- lā·mōw
verses.literal: The caravans of Tema look [for water] the travelers of Sheba hope to find it

verses.original: בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִּֽי־ בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗יהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bō·šū kî- ḇā·ṭāḥ bå̄·ʾū ‘ā·ḏe·hā way·yeḥ·pā·rū
verses.literal: They are confounded because they had hoped their arrival - brings disappointment

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם לֹא תִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַתִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh hĕ·yî·ṯem lō tir·’ū ḥă·ṯaṯ wat·tî·rā·’ū
verses.literal: For now you are of no help you see terror and you are afraid

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽכִי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑י שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽי׃ וּ֝מִכֹּחֲכֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: hăḵî- ’ā·mar·tî hā·ḇū lî ši·ḥă·ḏū ḇa·‘ă·ḏî ū·mik·kō·ḥă·ḵem
verses.literal: Have I ever said Give me something offer me a bribe . . . from your wealth

verses.original: וּמַלְּט֥וּנִי מִיַּד־ צָ֑ר תִּפְדּֽוּנִי׃ וּמִיַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·lə·ṭū·nî mî·yaḏ- ṣār tip̄·dū·nî ū·mî·yaḏ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm
verses.literal: deliver me from the hand of the enemy redeem me from the grasp of the ruthless

verses.original: ה֭וֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃ וּמַה־ שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי
verses.transliteration: hō·w·rū·nî wa·’ă·nî ’a·ḥă·rîš hā·ḇî·nū lî ū·ma·hō·šā- šā·g̲î·t̲î
verses.literal: Teach me and I will be silent Help me understand how I have erred

verses.original: מַה־ נִּמְרְצ֥וּ יֹ֑שֶׁר אִמְרֵי־ וּמַה־ יּוֹכִ֖יחַ מִכֶּֽם׃ הוֹכֵ֣חַ
verses.transliteration: mah- nim·rə·ṣū yō·šer ’im·rê- ū·mah- yō·w·ḵî·aḥ mik·kem hō·w·ḵê·aḥ
verses.literal: How painful [are] honest words But what does your argument . . . prove

verses.original: תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ הַלְהוֹכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים וּ֝לְר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: taḥ·šō·ḇū hal·hō·w·ḵaḥ mil·lîm ū·lə·rū·aḥ ’im·rê nō·’āš
verses.literal: Do you intend to correct my words and treat as wind my cry of despair

verses.original: תַּפִּ֑ילוּ יָת֥וֹם וְ֝תִכְר֗וּ עַל־ אַף־ עַל־ רֵֽיעֲכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tap·pî·lū yā·ṯō·wm wə·ṯiḵ·rū ‘al- ’ap̄- ‘al- rê·‘ă·ḵem
verses.literal: You would even cast lots for an orphan and barter away . . . . . . your friend

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה הוֹאִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ־ בִ֑י אֲכַזֵּֽב׃ וְעַל־ פְּ֝נֵיכֶ֗ם אִם־
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hō·w·’î·lū p̄ə·nū- ḇî ’ă·ḵaz·zêḇ wə·‘al- pə·nê·ḵem ’im-
verses.literal: But now please look at me Would I lie to your face . . .

verses.original: שֻֽׁבוּ־ נָ֭א אַל־ תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וְשֻׁבִי צִדְקִי־ ע֝וֹד בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šu·ḇū- nā ’al- tə·hî ‘aw·lāh wə·šu·ḇī ṣiḏ·qî- ‘ō·wḏ ḇāh
verses.literal: Reconsider . . . do not be unjust Reconsider for my righteousness . . . is at stake

verses.original: הֲיֵשׁ־ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֥י אִם־ חִ֝כִּ֗י לֹא־ יָבִ֥ין הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yêš- ‘aw·lāh bil·šō·w·nî ’im- ḥik·kî lō- yā·ḇîn haw·wō·wṯ
verses.literal: Is there iniquity on my tongue Can my mouth not discern malice
